Players Committee card image of [[I Can't Shake Him! (V)]] (original printing), game text: “For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent's starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent's deploy phase, deploy an Imperial of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/icantshakehim.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
